Allen Integrated Solutions is seeking a highly skilled Subject Matter Expert in Overhead Persistent Infrared (OPIR) research engineering to support the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) in infrared sensing, space-based missile warning systems, data exploitation, and algorithm development. The ideal candidate will possess an extensive technical background in electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) systems, infrared phenomenology, OPIR data analysis, and remote-sensing software development. This role requires demonstrated experience working with complex sensor systems, leading the development and testing of advanced analytical capabilities, and collaborating with government, industry, and research partners on next-generation sensing technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the prototyping and development of advanced OPIR data-processing algorithms and support their transition into operational environments.
  • Evaluate and troubleshoot data-processing pipelines, identify anomalies, and coordinate remediation strategies.
  • Support the development of white papers, technical documentation, and technology-transition plans.
  • Collaborate with research organizations, Department of Defense stakeholders, Intelligence Community organizations, and external agencies.

Required Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, physics, computer science, or a related technical field.
  • At least 15 years of experience in EO/IR algorithm development.
  • Advanced understanding of EO/IR signal processing, artificial intelligence and machine learning applications, and target-system phenomenology.
  • Detailed experience with OPIR data formats and processing pipelines.
  • Advanced Python development skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose sensor-performance issues, data anomalies, and software problems.

Desired Qualifications

  • Direct experience performing OPIR analysis.
  • Master’s degree in computer engineering, physics, computer science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience collaborating with NGA, NASIC, or other Intelligence Community organizations.

Position Overview

Allen Integrated Solutions is seeking a highly skilled Remote Sensing OPIR Engineer to support the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) in infrared sensing, space-based missile warning systems, data exploitation, and algorithm development. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) systems, infrared phenomenology, Overhead Persistent Infrared (OPIR) data analysis, and remote-sensing software development.

This role requires demonstrated experience working with complex sensor systems, developing and testing advanced analytical capabilities, and collaborating with government, industry, and research partners on next-generation sensing technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Support the prototyping and development of advanced OPIR data-processing algorithms and their transition into operational environments.
  • Evaluate and troubleshoot data-processing pipelines, identify anomalies, and coordinate remediation strategies.

  • Collaborate with research organizations, Department of Defense stakeholders, Intelligence Community organizations, and external agencies.

Required Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, physics, computer science, or a related technical field.
  • At least two years of experience in EO/IR algorithm development.
  • Advanced understanding of EO/IR signal processing, artificial intelligence and machine learning applications, and target-system phenomenology.
  • Detailed experience with OPIR data formats and processing pipelines.
  • Advanced Python development skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose sensor-performance issues, data anomalies, and software problems.

Desired Qualifications

  • Direct experience performing OPIR analysis.
  • Master’s degree in computer engineering, physics, computer science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience collaborating with NGA, NASIC, or other Intelligence Community organizations.

title: Senior Product Engineer
description: Hey there! We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. We are looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join our Data Team. This is a role for an engineer who cares deeply about product impact, user experience, and how systems connect to real business outcomes. You will work across the full stack, from the interfaces users interact with to the services and data layers that power them, and bridge the gap between our AI and data capabilities and the products people actually use. You won't just take tickets and ship code. You'll own features end-to-end: shaping the problem with Product and Design, building it, defining success metrics, and iterating based on real data. If you thrive in ambiguous, high-leverage environments, love shipping with judgment, and want your engineering work to be visibly tied to outcomes that matter, you'll fit right in. Tech environment This role is intentionally not defined by one framework or specialty. That said, you will likely operate across the full stack: a modern TypeScript web platform where several frontends and frameworks coexist, and where moving between them matters more than allegiance to one, that also ships inside our native apps through webviews and a native/web bridge; Python-based services and APIs; relational, NoSQL, and search datastores, data warehouses, and SQL; event-driven and distributed systems; cloud infrastructure, containers, and CI/CD pipelines; and observability tooling. Depending on the project, you may also work with LLM APIs and agent-based workflows, retrieval patterns, data orchestration, and product analytics and A/B experimentation. Nice to have Strong TypeScript and depth in at least one modern web framework. Our web platform is a large monorepo combining several frontends, where Angular and Astro/Svelte coexist. Comfort moving across frameworks matters more than allegiance to one. Strong componentization skills: designing reusable components and shared modules whose logic lives in framework-agnostic packages, including web features that ship inside our native apps through webviews and JavaScript/native bridges. Our apps are Kotlin/Jetpack Compose and Swift/SwiftUI; you won't own them, but you'll integrate deeply with them. Sound judgment on when to render server-side vs client-side (or hybrid), driven by functional and non-functional requirements such as SEO, performance, personalization, and caching, rather than framework defaults. Experience working on internal platforms, operational tools, or product-heavy backend systems. Experience with Python frameworks such as Django or FastAPI. Experience with PostgreSQL, Snowflake, DynamoDB, Redis, OpenSearch, and SQL-heavy applications. Familiarity with event-driven architectures or messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ. Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar infrastructure patterns. Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (Datadog or similar). Exposure to AI-enabled product development: LLM integrations, agent frameworks (LangGraph/LangChain), LLM observability (Langfuse), RAG patterns, or workflow automation. Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager. Product tracking at Fever runs through Dataverse, our in-house unified behavioural event layer built on server-side GTM, so knowing how GA and GTM work is enough to find your way around. We also use Mixpanel. Familiarity with product experimentation: A/B testing, feature flags, and edge-side experimentation. We bucket anonymous users and run rollouts at the CDN edge (CloudFront Functions), with Statsig and Optimizely as the experimentation platforms. Experience working on 0 to 1 initiatives or undefined problem spaces. Demonstrated leadership through ownership of difficult projects with broad impact. What success looks like You turn ambiguous opportunities into working systems or products that create clear value. You help teams make better trade-offs and avoid overengineering, fragmentation, and local optimization. You improve not only what gets built, but also how decisions are made. You become a trusted technical leader for important cross-functional initiatives. You increase the leverage of other engineers and teams through your judgment, technical direction, and execution support. You help connect engineering work to real operational and business outcomes. Who will thrive in this role You will likely thrive here if: You are energized by ambitious, messy, high-leverage problems. You like operating where priorities evolve and the path is not fully defined. You care more about impact than about staying inside a narrowly defined engineering lane. You enjoy combining engineering depth, product thinking, and business context. You naturally look for the highest-leverage way to move a system, a team, or a product forward. You want to play a meaningful role in shaping how the company builds and scales. Why join Fever You will work on some of the company's most strategic problems. You will have real ownership and visible impact. You will help shape products, systems, and capabilities that matter across the business. You will work in an environment that values ambition, adaptability, pragmatism, and execution. You will be surrounded by smart, driven people who care about building things that matter. Benefits & Perks Flexible schedule Bonus Stock options 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences Health insurance from Day 1 English or Spanish Lessons Wellhub Membership Cobee (tax free allowance on restaurants and transport) Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you! If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu | TechCrunch Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply! If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey. raw.jobDescription:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.

About the Team

Secret Media Network is a digital media group focused on recommending perfect plans, discovering great places, sharing things to do and relevant breaking news in different cities around the world. Our family is composed of Secret Chicago, Secret LA, Secret NYC, Secret Atlanta, Secret Miami, Secret Toronto, Secret London, Lisboa Secreta, Paris Secret, Madrid Secreto, Barcelona Secreta and more! Through our media outlets we inspire over 60 million people every week to discover the best experiences in their cities. https://secretmedianetwork.com/en/

What would you do at Fever?

During your first month at Fever (Onboarding period)

  • Full immersion into our team, participating in team planning, grooming, and retrospectives.
  • Familiarization with our tech stack, focusing on the Secret Media Network, CI/CD workflows, and infrastructure.
  • Multiple successful Pull Requests merged and deployed to production.
  • Participation in Fever Original's experiences like Candlelight.

After 3 months at Fever:

  • Proficiency in solving complex problems and taking charge of architecture design and implementation.
  • Continual creation of production-grade PHP code capable of handling high levels of traffic, with a keen eye on functionality and product enhancement.
  • Working closely with internal stakeholders to define and prioritize product development
  • Collaboration in hackdays or hackathons with other teams, becoming well-acquainted with the entire engineering department.

In your 6th month at Fever:

  • Assume responsibilities for various system components, analyzing user interactions and evolving the platform to meet their needs.
  • Participation in launching large scale initiatives, from inception to production.
  • Ideating and implementing initiatives to ensure the system performance and reliability
  • Mentorship of fellow team members through code reviews, architecture design sessions, and pair programming.
  • Engagement in team-building activities, fostering a cohesive engineering team spirit.

About you

  • You’re smart, get stuff done, have great energy, and thrive in a fast paced environment
  • Deep knowledge on Wordpress, PHP and Symfony framework.
  • You know how to create/modify Wordpress plugins and themes.
  • You know how to handle several Wordpress sites.
  • You are experienced handling DDBB such as MySQL.
  • You have experience working through cross-browser compatibility issues.
  • You are highly productive, self-starter and self-motivated.
  • You comply with defined coding standards.
  • You are proficient in business English.

Additional Skills:

  • Know how to create WP plugins and themes from scratch
  • Systems knowledge (Cache, Load balancers, ...)
  • Familiar with JIRA

Benefits & Perks

  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
  • Stock options.
  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Home office friendly (based in Spain)
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
  • Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee.
  • English Lessons
  • Gympass Membership
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow.
  • Salary range: 35 - 50 k

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers. Why this role exists Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability. Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused. Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements. Thought leadership Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach. Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks. Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab. Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability. What you’ll bring Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems. Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security. Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems. Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments. Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns. Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery. Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations. The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority. Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization. Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools. Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior. Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents. A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems. Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments. description: Hi there! We're Testlio , a global software testing company that has been helping businesses improve their digital products since 2012. We work with companies around the world to test websites, mobile apps, and online payment systems. Our freelance community helps identify issues and make sure these products work as expected for real customers. Learn more about us at www.testlio.com . About This Opportunity We're looking for people in Italy, Belgium, and Germany to help us test how local payment methods work when paying for advertising on Facebook and Instagram through Meta Ads Manager. Requirements: Location & Payment Method: Italy: Satispay account. Belgium: Wero activated with a Belgian bank account. Germany: Wero activated with a German bank account. Have access to Meta Ads Manager, or be willing to create an account. Have an iOS/Android device or a computer with an updated browser, plus a smartphone with the required payment app. Comfortable following instructions and submitting feedback in English. Available to start ASAP and complete testing by November 16, 2026. Duration: Approximately 1.5 hours. Compensation: Paid hourly testing assignment. Don't have Satispay or Wero yet? Hi there! We're Testlio, a global software testing company that has been helping businesses improve their digital products since 2012.
We work with companies around the world to test websites, mobile apps, and online payment systems. Our freelance community helps identify issues and make sure these products work as expected for real customers.
Learn more about us at www.testlio.com.

About This Opportunity

We're looking for people in Italy, Belgium, and Germany to help us test how local payment methods work when paying for advertising on Facebook and Instagram through Meta Ads Manager.

Requirements:

  • Location & Payment Method:
    • Italy: Satispay account.
    • Belgium: Wero activated with a Belgian bank account.
    • Germany: Wero activated with a German bank account.
  • Have access to Meta Ads Manager, or be willing to create an account.
  • Have an iOS/Android device or a computer with an updated browser, plus a smartphone with the required payment app.
  • Comfortable following instructions and submitting feedback in English.
  • Available to start ASAP and complete testing by November 16, 2026.
  • Duration: Approximately 1.5 hours.
  • Compensation: Paid hourly testing assignment.

Don't have Satispay or Wero yet? You can still apply if you're willing and eligible to set it up before testing.

What You'll Do:

  • Follow step-by-step instructions from our testing team.

  • Complete a small advertising payment of approximately €5.
  • Check whether the payment goes through successfully.
  • Report any errors or unexpected behavior, including screenshots when needed.

Online payment methods can work differently depending on the country, bank, and device. That's why companies need local people to help check that payments are processed correctly.

title: Software Engineer, Systems Architecture
description: Valinor is a new type of defense and government tech company focused on solving the problems others don't. Our unique model of centralized go-to-market and decentralized engineering allows us to move with unparalleled efficiency to identify unmet needs, build right-sized solutions, and get products where they matter most - in the hands of users. Unlike others in the space, who focus on the flashy problems, Valinor exists to solve the quiet, unaddressed problems-the small but significant ones that lead to cracks in the country's strength, stability, and security. Backed by General Catalyst, Founders Fund, and Friends & Family Capital, Valinor was founded in 2024 and has established strategic partnerships with Palantir, Anduril, and Helsing. We are building the dream team, and we want you on it. About The Role We're looking for a software engineer to own the architecture, data handling, and product layer of the software stack at one of Valinor’s product companies, currently in stealth. The system turns raw sensor data into a usable, trusted picture for the end user. You'll work directly with the General Manager and alongside a small team of engineers to rapidly develop a new product. You’ll also partner with product enablement at the Valinor Hub to stand up infrastructure and management. We see this as a step-up role: someone who has already been part of building a system like this, whether embedded/edge software, sensor or data pipelines, or detection and classification work, as a strong contributor, and is ready to own that kind of architecture for the first time, with direct partnership from the GM on the highest-stakes tradeoffs. What You'll Do 1. Overall Software Architecture Design the software architecture that ties the products data flow, processing, and user-facing product together end to end. Define clean interfaces with the sensor integration and API work, so the pieces fit into a coherent whole rather than a collection of one-offs. Make and document the core architecture decisions early, since the system needs to flex as we learn what the product needs to become. 2. Data Handling & Pipeline Architect the edge vs. cloud processing split — what runs on-system under power/compute constraints versus what gets backhauled. Stand up time-series and object storage systems for sensor and telemetry data, and the ingestion pipeline that gets data from the system to backend reliable. Design for bandwidth-constrained, compression-aware data transport, and build in the data versioning and observability needed to trust what's flowing in as sensor types multiply. 3. Detection, Classification & Pattern-of-life Work with various sensor modalities, including acoustic, EO/IR, radar, RF/AIS, and others, to build detection and classification capability — starting with classical signal-processing methods where appropriate, and applied ML where it earns its complexity. Contribute to pattern-of-life anomaly detection work. Fuse multi-modal signals into a single detection/classification output. 4. User Interface — Configuration & Visualization Build the product configuration interface and the geospatial data visualization layer (the common operating picture) the end customer will actually use. What We're Looking For Required Architecture contribution, ready to lead: you've been part of a small team that designed and built a system with real architectural stakes — edge/embedded software, sensor or data pipelines, or similar — and you're ready to own that kind of system yourself for the first time. Data pipeline and storage experience: comfortable designing and operating time-series data systems and message-based ingestion pipelines (MQTT, Kafka, or equivalent), including handling for intermittent/unreliable connectivity. Full-stack range: comfortable moving between backend/data pipeline work (Python, Go, or similar) and frontend (React/TypeScript) without needing a specialist for each; enough familiarity with embedded/edge constraints to architect around them, even if you're not writing firmware yourself. At least one sensing/signal domain: hands-on experience with at least one of acoustic, EO/IR, or radar signal processing or detection — and genuine excitement to pick up the others as the product grows into them. Cloud infrastructure ownership: able to stand up and maintain CI/CD and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; GovCloud experience a plus) without a dedicated DevOps function yet in place. Step-up temperament: proven ability to build and rebuild quickly with loose specs, and comfort taking ownership of a decision you'd previously have brought to someone else. Strongly Preferred TAK (or similar government system) integration experience: hands-on work integrating with TAK (ATAK/WinTAK/TAK Server) or a comparable government C2/situational-awareness system is a significant plus. Applied ML experience, particularly anomaly detection or pattern-of-life modeling. Prior experience in defense or dual-use tech, including familiarity with the general shape of DoD software requirements (security, data handling, eventual ATO/RMF processes). Geospatial visualization experience (Mapbox, Cesium, deck.gl , or similar). Prior experience on an autonomous systems, robotics, or maritime/subsea platform. What Valinor Offers Competitive salary, equity packages, and benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance - fully covered for employees, 401K, development stipends, among others. Unlimited PTO and two-week company holiday at the end of every calendar year. We are a pro-mental health and pro-family company - we actually encourage employees to spend time with themselves and their families. Valinor also provides fertility benefits to those just beginning that journey. Fun work environment - we like to laugh and take care of each other, but we also deeply respect the mission in front of us. This role requires the candidate be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. Active clearance preferred, but not required. Valinor is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. The Valinor team is made up of incredibly talented and unique individuals, who together are disrupting industry norms by creating new paths towards the future of defense and government technology. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. We actively encourage members of recognized minorities, women, Veterans, and those with disabilities to apply, and we work to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all applicants throughout the interview process. If you are someone passionate about working on problems that have a real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you!

Valinor is a new type of defense and government tech company focused on solving the problems others don't. Our unique model of centralized go-to-market and decentralized engineering allows us to move with unparalleled efficiency to identify unmet needs, build right-sized solutions, and get products where they matter most - in the hands of users. Unlike others in the space, who focus on the flashy problems, Valinor exists to solve the quiet, unaddressed problems-the small but significant ones that lead to cracks in the country's strength, stability, and security.

Backed by General Catalyst, Founders Fund, and Friends & Family Capital, Valinor was founded in 2024 and has established strategic partnerships with Palantir, Anduril, and Helsing. We are building the dream team, and we want you on it.

About The Role

Valinor Streamline is looking for an experienced Software Engineer to help build and evolve the backend systems and foundational infrastructure behind our growing platform. You'll join a small, highly collaborative team with significant ownership over the technical foundation of the product and the decisions that shape it as we grow.

We're looking for someone who has built software that real customers depend on and understands what it takes to improve and scale those systems while keeping them running. This role is ideal for a strong backend engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, isn't afraid to get into the weeds with infrastructure, and is excited to help shape a product at an early stage.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain the backend services and foundational platform components that power Streamline's products and enable other engineers to ship high quality software.

  • Own and execute complex migrations and architectural improvements to production systems while maintaining reliability and minimizing disruption to customers.

  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across backend systems, improving how data is accessed, processed, and delivered as the platform scales.

  • Own technical problems end-to-end, from architectural design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization.

  • Work closely with a small engineering team to make pragmatic technical decisions, balance immediate product needs with long-term scalability, and help shape the technical direction of the platform.

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong foundation in backend development and a track record of building and operating production systems.

  • Deep understanding of backend architecture, distributed systems, databases, caching, and performance optimization.

  • Experience evolving complex production systems, including executing migrations and making architectural changes without compromising reliability or availability.

  • Experience working in engineering environments where scalability, performance, and reliability are critical, ideally at a growing startup or established technology company.

  • Strong programming skills and comfort working across backend services and infrastructure

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to navigate complex codebases, design thoughtful abstractions, and evaluate tradeoffs between simplicity, performance, and maintainability.

  • A builder's mentality, intellectual curiosity, and comfort taking ownership in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment. Experience founding a company, building independent projects, or working at an early-stage startup is a plus.

What Valinor Offers

  • Competitive salary, equity packages, and benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance - fully covered for employees, 401(k), development stipends, among others.

  • Unlimited PTO and two-week company holiday at the end of every calendar year.

  • We are a pro-mental health and pro-family company - we actually encourage employees to spend time with themselves and their families. Valinor also provides fertility benefits to those just beginning that journey.

  • Fun work environment - we like to laugh and take care of each other, but we also deeply respect the mission in front of us.

title: Full Stack Web Engineer
description: Location: Remote – Latin America (Open to applicants located anywhere in the LATAM region) Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria's Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR. As a Full Stack Web Engineer at Fueled, your mission is to turn well-defined tickets and user stories into clean, production-ready code that powers large-scale digital experiences. Working within enterprise WordPress engagements, you'll build and deliver features end-to-end, from the frontend experience to modern PHP, JavaScript, and Gutenberg blocks in React.js. You'll bring designs and requirements to life within themes and plugins, moving quickly and confidently by pairing your own craft with AI-assisted workflows, thorough documentation, and the support of senior engineers who review and elevate your work. This is a role for engineers who love the craft: you write code you're proud of, you welcome sharp code review, and you treat AI tools as a force multiplier, not a substitute for understanding. You should be comfortable taking a feature from requirements through implementation, making sound decisions along the way, and delivering a polished, production-ready result. Your work will ship to platforms serving millions of visitors, alongside a team recognized as one of the top enterprise WordPress practices in the world. Intentionally remote, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. For engineers in Latin America, that means real-time collaboration with US-based teams during your normal working day, compensation in USD, and a seat at the table on projects for globally recognized brands – all from wherever you work best. Together, we're shaping the future of digital experiences. What you will do: Build features for enterprise-level WordPress solutions – custom Gutenberg blocks in React.js, plugins, and themes using modern HTML/CSS and well-structured PHP. Own tickets end-to-end: understand the requirements, make sound decisions when details are incomplete, and deliver reviewable pull requests with clear summaries of your approach, assumptions, and testing. Bring designs and user experiences to life by translating Figma designs and other project requirements into polished, responsive features and reusable components within WordPress themes and plugins. Leverage AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow to accelerate implementation and debugging while critically validating every output before it reaches a pull request. Iterate on code review feedback from senior and lead engineers, absorbing patterns and best practices that sharpen your craft with every merge. Collaborate proactively and asynchronously in English with distributed teammates across engineering, design, and delivery. What you will achieve: Within your first month, you'll have shipped merged, production-ready pull requests on a live client project, demonstrating that you can take written direction and run with it. By the 3-month mark, you'll be independently owning tickets from requirement to release, with review cycles getting shorter as your grasp of our conventions deepens. Your AI-assisted workflow will have measurably accelerated delivery on your project – without ever compromising the quality bar our clients expect. You'll have earned the trust of your engineering leads as a dependable contributor whose PRs are a pleasure to review. By the end of your contract, you'll have a portfolio of enterprise-grade work, sharpened skills, and a standing invitation for future collaboration. About you: You have solid agency or consultancy experience building WordPress solutions for large-scale, enterprise projects – high-traffic sites, demanding clients, real deadlines. You're comfortable working across the web stack, including HTML, CSS, modern PHP, JavaScript, and the Gutenberg ecosystem, including building custom blocks with React.js. Bonus points if you've worked with our open-source tools, like ElasticPress or ClassifAI – tell us about it in your application. AI tools are already part of how you work: you use them to move faster, and you know exactly when they're wrong. You're passionate about sharpening your craft – you read best practices for fun, seek out code review, and never ship code you don't understand. You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken, and can confidently walk a reviewer through your decisions, assumptions, and tradeoffs. You're based in Latin America, and thrive on a distributed team, collaborating in real time with US time zones from the remote location of your choice. Contractor Fee Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, projects, geographic location, and business needs. Contractor fees are paid in USD. Join our Contractor Pool This role is designed as a contract position, offering you the opportunity to experience our team and culture while showcasing your contributions. When the fit and business needs align, some contractors are invited to explore a transition into full-time roles. If you are passionate about Fueled's mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, even if you don't check all the boxes – please apply. We'd appreciate the opportunity to review your application. Everyone gets a response. Upon meeting the necessary criteria, you'll join the Fueled contractor network, granting you access to project invitations tailored to your expertise and availability when they arise. Any data provided will be processed in accordance with applicable law and our privacy policy . Curious about what to expect during our talent process? Check it out here .

You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs. We want to help people live longer, healthier lives, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. Practice Management Systems (PMS) Build the next generation of software to help doctors globally. Unify the current fragmented reality and leverage AI to reinvent the way to help doctors focus on what matters most: treating the patient. AI-powered Clinical Tools (Noa Medic) Design AI-native clinical workflows that move beyond simple scribing to replace end-to-end administrative tasks. Patient & Data Integrations (Noa Patient) Move beyond the booking button to build a proactive healthcare partner. You like creating things that people use. Intellectual curiosity. You enjoy understanding how systems really work. Ownership. You treat problems as yours until they are solved. Pragmatism. You know when to optimize and when to ship. We value signals over credentials. Competition programming, open-source work, research, side projects or anything else that shows how you think. Millions of users and thousands of healthcare providers across multiple countries. Interesting problems. Distributed systems, search relevance, AI-assisted workflows, complex integrations. Exceptional teammates. Work with talented people across disciplines who raise the bar for everyone. Fast learning curve. You will work on real production systems very early. Meaningful mission. Helping people live longer, healthier lives. Qualifications Required Strong foundations in computer science Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, complexity, and core software engineering principles. Ability to build real software Comfortable working across the stack to design, implement, and ship features that solve real user problems. Strong problem-solving skills You enjoy breaking down complex problems and finding simple, effective solutions. Builder mindset You like turning ideas into working products and taking ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. Curiosity about users and problems You’re comfortable talking to users, understanding their needs, and iterating on solutions. High learning velocity You pick up new technologies, tools, and domains quickly and continuously improve your craft. AI-first engineering mindset You actively experiment with AI coding tools, agents, and new workflows, and are excited about reinventing how software is built. Preferred Academic background in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or another rigorous technical discipline. Competitive programming experience Participation in ICPC, Google Code Jam, national olympiads, Codeforces, or similar competitions. Evidence of building things Side projects, startups, open-source contributions, hackathons, or shipped products. Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling. Keep growing with us Free English classes. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.

title: Sr. Forward Deployed AI Engineer (Remote Eligible in the UK)
description: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day. You independently lead the most complex AI deployments Smartsheet undertakes. You own the full engagement lifecycle from technical discovery through production deployment through solutions org handoff. You architect multi-agent solutions, design client-personalized MCP resource packs, and build the Deployment Kits that transform how 200+ solutions consultants and partners operate. You mentor junior FDEs, drive the intelligence loop, and present field findings at weekly Applied AI strategy sessions. You are building a function, not filling a role. What You Will Do Lead complex, multi-system AI deployments end-to-end scope, architect, build, validate, and manage the customer relationship throughout. Own the AI workshop program for your pod, customize modules per customer, lead technical sessions, translate outputs into production requirements, evolve content from field learning. Architect multi-agent solutions selecting the right coordination pattern for each customer’s workflow characteristics and compliance requirements. Design client-specific and industry-specific MCP resource packs that serve personalized intelligence from the server so every connected AI surface gets smarter for that customer automatically. Own Deployment Kit quality for your pod. If a kit is not documented well enough for a solutions consultant with no engineering background to follow, it isn’t done. Lead Solutions Enablement Sprints: transfer AI deployment patterns to solutions consultants and partners with training materials and certification criteria. Drive the intelligence loop: author strategic memos, present field findings weekly, contribute Agent Bricks and Skills, file RFCs for platform improvements. Mentor junior FDEs on customer engagements, code reviews, and Deployment Kit quality. Required 6–10+ years production software engineering, including 3+ years deploying AI/ML to production. Deep Python; strong TypeScript/JavaScript. Proven track record leading complex enterprise technical engagements. You’ve managed customer relationships, navigated security reviews, and delivered production systems organisations depend on. Deep production LLM experience: multi-agent orchestration, MCP/tool-use, RAG optimisation, evaluation frameworks, agent deployment at scale. System architecture expertise spanning enterprise systems, cloud infrastructure, and AI services explainable to a CIO and a junior engineer. Demonstrated ability to create reusable technical assets that others use in production. You think in platforms, not projects. Strong written and verbal communication. Architecture documents, runbooks, strategic memos, training materials. Your Deployment Kits are your portfolio. You leave teams better than you found them. You make sure the people you work with understand what was built, why it works, and how to own it without you. Ability to travel. This role requires domestic and international travel approximately 25–50% of the time. Elligible to work in the UK on an ongoing basis BS or MS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent industry experience Nice to Have: Experience founding or scaling an FDE/solutions engineering function. Technical founder background. Databricks, AWS Bedrock, or Temporal experience. Deep domain knowledge in healthcare, financial services, or government. Agent framework contributions (Strands SDK, LangChain, open-source MCP servers). Proficiency in German/French language will be an added advantage Familiarity of AI governance, ethics, and regulatory requirements (e.g. GDPR, UK/EU AI Act) Get to Know Us: At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together. Equal Opportunity Employer: Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know. #LI-Remote

raw.jobDescription:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Admin & Identity and Access Management (Admin & IAM) team at Mural defines how users sign in, manage their identities, and access Mural's products, as well as how administrators configure and govern their organizations. We own authentication & authorization, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), user provisioning (SCIM), session management, and the core permission model that powers roles and access control across companies and workspaces. We also own the enterprise administration experience; the configuration and controls that company and workspace admins use to manage their organizations and users. By providing secure, clear, and intuitive controls for users and administrators, we help organizations adopt Mural quickly and collaborate with confidence.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Admin & IAM team, you will design and ship these capabilities end-to-end, from identity primitives like the permission model and authentication flows to the admin surfaces enterprise customers use every day. Senior Engineers on Admin & IAM own complex technical initiatives, influence platform and security best practices, and collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Infrastructure to deliver secure experiences that feel simple and intuitive. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work with a small, focused team in a remote-first environment, with the option to work from our Buenos Aires office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and evolve core identity and access systems that power authentication & authorization, SSO, user provisioning, session management, and permissions across Mural

  • Build and evolve the enterprise administration experience, including company and workspace configuration, user and content administration, billing, and internal admin tooling

  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to design and ship secure, intuitive access and administration experiences for users and administrators

  • Prototype, implement, and maintain Admin & IAM platform features, contributing as a technical expert and supporting teammates through collaboration and mentorship

  • Own technical initiatives from design through implementation, rollout, and operational support

  • Build flexible, observable and maintainable solutions while being accountable for security, quality, performance, and reliability

  • Use AI tools as a part of your fundamental workflows to improve productivity, code quality, and system understanding

  • Contribute to technical design discussions, provide thoughtful code reviews, mentor teammates, and continuously improve the quality of the team's engineering work

  • Contribute to continuously improving the team's processes and engineering best practices

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 4+ years building and shipping large-scale production software as part of an agile engineering team

  • Experience learning new technologies, platforms, and stacks, and getting productive quickly in large, existing codebases

  • An outcome-oriented and pragmatic interest in using AI-driven development practices to improve productivity, code quality, and system understanding

  • Strong experience building backend systems and APIs using Node.js, TypeScript / JavaScript, MongoDB, or comparable technologies

  • Hands-on experience building production user interfaces with React and modern frontend patterns

  • Proven ability to plan and deliver technical projects iteratively, balancing speed, quality, and long-term maintainability

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across product, design, security, and engineering partners

  • Experience working in a fast-moving or growth-stage environment, adapting to evolving requirements and priorities

  • Domain experience with identity and access management concepts such as authentication flows, authorization models, roles and permissions, SSO, SCIM provisioning, or session management

  • Experience building enterprise administration or B2B SaaS configuration surfaces, such as org management, billing, or admin dashboards

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. .

Equal Opportunity

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
